item.title: Weave GitOps vs Kubefirst vs Cyclops: Best Self-Hosted GitOps Dashboards 2026
item.description: GitOps has become the standard for managing Kubernetes deployments — defining your infrastructure and applications as code in Git repositories, then letting automation sync the desired state to your clusters. But staring at YAML files and CLI output isn’t always the best way to understand what’s running across your environments. That’s where GitOps dashboards come in.
